article.title: 阅读 Text 4 · 年轻美国人正在重画成功路线图
article.background: 基于代际调查比较年轻人与年长者对成功人生的共同终点和不同路径，并借经济衰退后的就业、家庭与住房压力说明年轻一代的新优先级。

sentences.en: Against a backdrop of drastic changes in economy and population structure, younger Americans are drawing a new 21st-century road map to success, a latest poll has found.
sentences.zh: 一项最新民调发现，在经济与人口结构发生剧烈变化的背景下，美国年轻人正在绘制一张新的21世纪成功路线图。

segments.text: Against a backdrop of drastic changes in economy and population structure, younger Americans are drawing a new 21st-century road map to success, a latest poll has found.

sentences.en: Across generational lines, Americans continue to prize many of the same traditional milestones of a successful life, including getting married, having children, owning a home, and retiring in their sixties.
sentences.zh: 跨越不同代际，美国人依然看重许多相同的传统成功标志，包括结婚、生子、拥有自己的住房，以及在六十多岁时退休。

segments.text: Across generational lines, Americans continue to prize many of the same traditional milestones of a successful life, including getting married, having children, owning a home, and retiring in their sixties.

sentences.en: But while young and old mostly agree on what constitutes the finish line of a fulfilling life, they offer strikingly different paths for reaching it.
sentences.zh: 但尽管年轻人与年长者大体认同充实人生的终点是什么，他们对如何抵达这个终点却给出了截然不同的路径。

segments.text: But while young and old mostly agree on what constitutes the finish line of a fulfilling life, they offer strikingly different paths for reaching it.

sentences.en: Young people who are still getting started in life were more likely than older adults to prioritize personal fulfillment in their work, to believe they will advance their careers most by regularly changing jobs, to favor communities with more public services and a faster pace of life, to agree that couples should be financially secure before getting married or having children, and to maintain that children are best served by two parents working outside the home, the survey found.
sentences.zh: 调查发现，那些刚刚开启成年生活的年轻人，比年长者更可能把工作中的个人满足感放在优先位置，更相信定期换工作最有利于职业发展，更青睐公共服务更多、生活节奏更快的社区，也更赞同夫妻应在经济稳定后再结婚或生育，并认为父母双方都在外工作更有利于孩子。

segments.text: Young people who are still getting started in life were more likely than older adults to prioritize personal fulfillment in their work, to believe they will advance their careers most by regularly changing jobs, to favor communities with more public services and a faster pace of life, to agree that couples should be financially secure before getting married or having children, and to maintain that children are best served by two parents working outside the home, the survey found.

sentences.en: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.
sentences.zh: 从职业、社区到家庭，这些差异表明，在严重的大衰退之后，刚刚开始独立生活的一代正在形成新的优先事项和期待，而这些观念将日益渗透到美国生活几乎所有方面，从消费偏好、住房模式一直到政治。

segments.text: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.

sentences.en: Young and old converge on one key point: Overwhelming majorities of both groups said they believe it is harder for young people today to get started in life than it was for earlier generations.
sentences.zh: 年轻人与年长者在一个关键点上意见一致：两组中绝大多数人都认为，如今年轻人开启独立生活比以往几代人更困难。

segments.text: Young and old converge on one key point: Overwhelming majorities of both groups said they believe it is harder for young people today to get started in life than it was for earlier generations.

sentences.en: While younger people are somewhat more optimistic than their elders about the prospects for those starting out today, big majorities in both groups believe those "just getting started in life" face a tougher climb than earlier generations in reaching such signpost achievements as securing a good-paying job, starting a family, managing debt, and finding affordable housing.
sentences.zh: 尽管年轻人对当代初入社会者的前景比年长者稍微乐观一些，但两组中的大多数人都相信，如今“刚刚起步的人”在实现一些标志性成就时要比前几代人攀登得更艰难，例如找到薪资不错的工作、组建家庭、管理债务和找到负担得起的住房。

segments.text: While younger people are somewhat more optimistic than their elders about the prospects for those starting out today, big majorities in both groups believe those "just getting started in life" face a tougher climb than earlier generations in reaching such signpost achievements as securing a good-paying job, starting a family, managing debt, and finding affordable housing.

sentences.en: Pete Schneider considers the climb tougher today.
sentences.zh: 皮特·施奈德认为，如今这段上坡路确实更难走。

segments.text: Pete Schneider considers the climb tougher today.

sentences.en: Schneider, a 27-year-old auto technician from the Chicago suburbs, says he struggled to find a job after graduating from college.
sentences.zh: 施奈德27岁，是芝加哥郊区的一名汽车技师；他说自己大学毕业后曾为找工作苦苦挣扎。

segments.text: Schneider, a 27-year-old auto technician from the Chicago suburbs, says he struggled to find a job after graduating from college.

sentences.en: Even now that he is working steadily, he said, "I can't afford to pay my monthly mortgage payments on my own, so I have to rent rooms out to people to make that happen."
sentences.zh: 即便现在工作已经稳定，他仍说：“我一个人负担不起每月的房贷，所以不得不把房间租给别人，才能把贷款还上。”

segments.text: Even now that he is working steadily, he said, "I can't afford to pay my monthly mortgage payments on my own, so I have to rent rooms out to people to make that happen."

sentences.en: Looking back, he is struck that his parents could provide a comfortable life for their children even though neither had completed college when he was young.
sentences.zh: 回望过去，他惊讶于父母年轻时虽然都没有大学学历，却仍能让孩子过上舒适的生活。

segments.text: Looking back, he is struck that his parents could provide a comfortable life for their children even though neither had completed college when he was young.

sentences.en: "I still grew up in an upper middle-class home with parents who didn't have college degrees," Schneider said.
sentences.zh: 施奈德说：“我的父母没有大学学位，但我依然是在一个中上阶层家庭长大的。

segments.text: "I still grew up in an upper middle-class home with parents who didn't have college degrees," Schneider said.

sentences.en: "I don't think people are capable of that anymore."
sentences.zh: 我觉得现在的人已经很难再做到这一点了。”

segments.text: "I don't think people are capable of that anymore."
